allocation.expiryNote: No expiry is specified in the read-only allocation. No external resource or future operation authority is inferred.

approvedTestOnlyAccount.evidence: No approved dedicated TEST account/ownership/mode receipt was present in the sanctioned handoffs inspected. No account or credential store was accessed; existence/availability is not disproved.

gateway.mechanism: Existing Worker Env bindings consumed as c.env by canonical hosted checkout

webhook.mechanism: Existing webhook-service Env bindings; raw-body receiver POST /razorpay
webhook.conditionalRequirement: Any provider lookup/notes resolution must use credentials for the same approved Test account; interface optionality is not account/mode proof.

secureBindingMechanism.merchantUiSettings: The inspected hosted gateway branch directly uses gateway Env credentials; an encrypted merchant own-account settings receipt alone cannot prove this runtime is bound.

injectionAndMode.requirement: Confirm actual Test account/key mode and absence of HOSTED_RAZORPAY_TEST_ADAPTER substitution for the real-purchase lane. Source sandbox labels or native adapter fakes are not provider proof.

syntheticScope.requirement: Allocator admits one coherent fresh owned fixture with exact source/package/schema/runtime identity and synthetic buyer/site/cart/order boundaries. Old936/Marketplace/Threadline sessions and bindings are excluded. Each of ten themes still needs its own actual normal Test Mode browser purchase.

publicHttpsWebhook.requirement: Existing owned public HTTPS test routing accepted by Razorpay and bound to the admitted receiver/account/secret. No localhost/synthetic POST delivery claim, tunnel creation, deployment or exposure under this read-only allocation.

captureAndMethods.sourceRequires: Gateway confirm fetches real provider payment and requires captured=true/status=captured, matching stored payment/order/amount/INR; authorized-only is pending.
captureAndMethods.requirement: Account owner attests the approved Test capture/method path before allocating the primary purchase; record actual provider state rather than assuming UI success means captured.

verificationEvidence.searchScope: Sanctioned current programme top-level Markdown/JSON contracts/ownership/allocation/native-admission receipts and named MadeYours/Kindred readiness handoffs. Filename discovery of relevant implementation readiness files; no ambient environment/secret or private old-state scanning.
verificationEvidence.negativeConclusionIsBounded: Missing admission receipts in the inspected scope do not prove accounts, credentials or ingress do not exist.

exactRemainingPrerequisite: A current nonsecret owner-approved TEST account + secure runtime binding + accepted owned HTTPS webhook + synthetic-scope/expiry/cleanup admission receipt. No current runtime/browser grant exists.

coordinatorSetupInstruction.firstAction: Consult the already authorized credential/ingress owner for the existing receipt; if no owner-approved detail is available, ask the human once with the consolidated instruction.
coordinatorSetupInstruction.nonsecretInstruction: Identify the existing approved dedicated Razorpay TEST account/credential owner and an existing owned, provider-accepted public HTTPS TEST webhook endpoint routed to canonical webhook-service /razorpay. Have the authorized owner bind the gateway TEST API pair and matching TEST webhook secret through protected runtime bindings, and provide a nonsecret admission receipt with account alias/approval, real-adapter selection, capture/test-method support, exact runtime/source identity, synthetic site/cart/order scope, endpoint routing/acceptance, matching-secret ownership, expiry and cleanup responsibility. Do not paste keys, tokens, secret values, real personal data or old fixture credentials. If either resource is not available, report which capability is unavailable; new account/ingress/configuration work needs its own allocation. The eventual Test payment is already in the completion objective and needs a current browser/runtime grant, not repeated approval of the goal.

futureExecutionEvidenceRequired: Normal browser PDP/cart/identity/hosted quote -> actual Razorpay TEST Checkout -> server verification -> actual provider webhook
Redacted provider/local order/payment/event linkage, mode/account, amount/currency, captured state and exact source/runtime inputs
Canonical order/payment/snapshot/inventory/reservation/ledger/outbox effects with balanced reconciliation and protected-state preservation
Shared unchanged-input decline/dismiss/retry/signature/binding/replay/race/out-of-order/provider-success-local-failure cohort plus per-theme primary purchase
Canonical owned Test refund/reversal where required, exactly-one effects and no audit/order deletion or consumed-stock refill

expiryAndCleanup.currentReview: No account/config/provider/ingress/runtime resource acquired or changed; no resource lease to return. Allocator may close the read-only work item on receipt.
expiryAndCleanup.retained: Existing source/accepted artifacts/prior evidence and private heading proposal remain retained. No shared process, database, browser or old fixture was attached or cleaned.

priorChildReviewCorrection.kindredEarlierInference: An absent allowed_child_types was previously treated as no permitted nesting; that interpretation was wrong.
priorChildReviewCorrection.canonicalContract: Undefined is unrestricted for eligible installed first-party types; explicit empty list denies; explicit allowlist restricts. Preserve @app/unknown/depth/count guards.
priorChildReviewCorrection.currentDisposition: First shared block handoff/admission is conditional until followup03 passes. Prior source/tests remain historical; no full child/render/browser acceptance is carried forward. Required child capability coverage must be reconciled additively after that handoff, not waived from absence.
